journal.ops_emergency_migration.title: Emergency migration
journal.ops_emergency_migration.desc: Move the exposed workload before the provider closes the account.
log.ops_emergency_migration.data_moved: Workload data moved to the new site.
log.ops_emergency_migration.failed: The migration collapsed under investigation pressure.
journal.bi_abuse_desk.title: An open abuse report
journal.bi_abuse_desk.desc: A provider's abuse desk has a file with my traffic in it. It closes when the report is answered or when there is nothing left on the channels to report.
journal.bi_access_lost.title: The access is gone
journal.bi_access_lost.desc: A whole class of credentials was revoked at once. What is lost is the capacity: the research stays done and the operation can run again.
